name: neutral

why: Source reading: breath only; D6 names listening as a state-true emote (research plan:122). Showing it with the mic closed would be a false privacy claim.

name: thinking

why: Source reading: dots+breath; D6 names thinking as state-true (research plan:122). Only honest while a turn is really in flight.

name: laugh

name: asleep
live_condition: state.changed state=asleep (PROTOCOL.md:56; anim.rs:954, :1290)
why: Source reading: zzz 1, breath 2.5, bubble 0.8. Sleep is a D6 state-true emote. The bubble (emote.rs:501, drawn at the nose position) is nasal-bubble imagery and should be reviewed or dropped.

name: tired

why: Source reading: gloom 0.2 plus sweat 0.3 (strip the sweat). The tired pose is the low-battery cue (PROTOCOL.md:203).

name: bored

name: muted
